title: Kernel of the Q functor is the parasitic subcategory; Q is exact and bicontinuous
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Part (1) characterizes the kernel via restriction to the presentation cover, using flat base change to transfer vanishing to arbitrary flat points through the smooth-surjective (hence faithful) projection q. Part (3) is a snake-lemma argument: the adjunction map has parasitic kernel and cokernel, the bottom row is exact, the top row has parasitic cohomology, and right exactness of the inclusion computes the cokernel in both categories, forcing it to be simultaneously quasi-coherent and parasitic.
